fact: Art. 52 of Loi n° 2022-59 du 16 décembre 2022 names artificial intelligence and requires disclosure of criteria and data from collection, in force since 16 December 2022; there is no AI-specific statute, and the HAPDP was dissolved by Décret n° 2026-310/PRN/PM of 8 June 2026.
title: Niger: AI regulation & deadlines
